text:
leah: Heads-up 5 I opened a focused docs PR to standardize "per-1k tokens" language, add a compact Reserved->$/1k token conversion example (USD/EUR/GBP), and include a clear note about header behavior for Dedicated vs Hosted. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4242
owen: I'll run the pricing sanity checks tonight. Quick Q: do we want to show examples for monthly reserved slots only, or also hourly throughput conversions? Customers ask both.
maya: I added two SDK snippets: a short Node snippet using `client.usage.getQuota()` and a tiny Python example showing header reads. Node: ```js
// Node example
const q = await client.usage.getQuota({ customerId });
console.log(`tier=${q.tier} burst=${q.burstRemaining}`);
```
Python headers snippet: ```py
# Python requests example
resp = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=body)
remaining = resp.headers.get('X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining')
window = resp.headers.get('X-Redwood-Burst-Window-Seconds')
```
sam: Confirming headers from runtime: `X-Redwood-Quota-Remaining` and `X-Redwood-Burst-Window-Seconds`. Note: for Dedicated customers with private billing and metering disabled, these headers are not present. I've added that callout to the PR. Also fixed a broken /console/usage link.
jin: Small UX note: in the pricing examples we should show the rounding rules up front (we round to 2 decimals) and add a footnote about peak vs average throughput assumptions. I pushed a tiny paragraph.
owen: Pushed a compact conversion table: Reserved GPUs -> tokens/sec -> monthly cost -> effective $/1k tokens. Included EUR and GBP columns using the day's mid-market rates (note in docs that rates are illustrative). Also toggled the calculation to cap effective cost per-1k at 0.5% rounding error.
maya: The Grafana dashboard screenshot used `requests.count`. Replaced with `tokens.ingested` and attached the panel JSON (small panel snippet) so SEs can import it. Added a short import note: panel IDs may collide; recommend "Import as new dashboard".
leah: Please add a 4-item migration checklist for Hosted -> Dedicated customers (bullet points). Keep it tight. Also label streaming vs non-streaming SDK examples clearly.
sam: Done5 checklist added in the PR comment: (1) meter differences & header availability, (2) how burst credits apply, (3) reserved pricing calc example, (4) recommended SDK changes (use `usage.getQuota()` helper). I also added an e2e smoke test that runs the Node snippet on Node 18 in CI.
devex-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-4242--docs.redwood.ai (linkscan: passed, snippet-lint: passed) :white_check_mark:
jin: One editorial nit: we had mixed "burst window" vs "burst window seconds". Standardized to "burst window (seconds)" in the text and left header name as-is.
leah: This looks good. If no more comments I'll request final reviews and merge once CI is green. Thanks all for the quick turnaround! :rocket:
